name: STURDeCAM57

sources.title: STURDeCAM57 - 5MP RGB-IR Global Shutter GMSL2 Camera (e-con Systems product page)
sources.covers: sensor (5MP, OmniVision Nyxel), shutter, chroma (colour and NIR), optical format, pixel size, active area, FOV, focus distance, frame rate, output, interface, power, size, board weight, IP67

note: An RGB-IR global-shutter GMSL2 camera in an IP67 enclosure, 940 nm IR LED (working range 50 cm to 2 m), fixed focus at 50-200 cm. The page names the sensor only as "5MP Sensor" (the URL names OX05B1S). FOV 114.76 (H) x 85.92 (V) x 148.32 (D) degrees. The lens model is pinhole, a labelled ASSUMPTION: the maker states no projection or distortion coefficients; calibrate a unit and store its K and D in the sensor calibration. Frame rate "RGB + IR : 2592 x 1946 @ 50 FPS (25 FPS RGB + 25 FPS IR)", UYVY; the stated stream height 1946 exceeds the stated active area 2592 x 1944, so no stream is entered until the datasheet (behind a form, not read) settles it. power_w is the stated typical 3.42 W (12 V). mass_g is the stated "Board weight" 100 g. size_mm: "70 x 35 x 30 mm (with enclosure)", entered as [70, 35, 30] on the reading that the 70 mm length is along the optical axis (an ASSUMPTION). Not stated: f-number, focal length, distortion.
interface: GMSL2 (FAKRA connector, cable up to 15 m)

imagers.name: RGB-IR
imagers.figures_conflict: The stated diagonal (148.32 deg) is wider than a centred, radially symmetric lens without pincushion distortion can show with the stated 114.76 x 85.92 deg across 2592 x 1944 px (at most about 143 deg). The library uses the horizontal and vertical angles.
